limitations: Menu rows are brand-level candidates, not exact branch menus; prices are included only when the official source publishes them (MOS Burger).
Burger King, Genki Sushi, Popeyes, and Chick-fil-A observed pages did not publish item prices in the captured menu pages; prices remain blank.
The Popeyes site page says prices may vary; page copyright footer is 2022 and page content version is undated, so freshness confidence is lower.
MOS Burger has explicit outlet-exclusive menu items; such item restriction is recorded in branch_availability_note and must not be assigned to all outlets.
McDonald’s and KFC were not rescanned because same-day menu snapshots already exist.
Image candidates are direct first-party URLs; their publication/reuse rights are not granted by this evidence and remain review-only.
No closure changes or ratings are proposed.
recommended_integration: Merge only net-new exact menu rows and official image URLs after checking branch scope and existing image sheet. Preserve blank prices where absent in source. Do not replace existing rows unless exact brand/item and branch/menu scope align.
